note: One protocol for every architecture. Changing a value here changes every run; there are no per-run edits. The single sanctioned deviation is the learning rate and batch size for smallcnn, which trains from scratch.

smallcnn.why: trains from scratch, so it needs a higher learning rate and tolerates a larger batch; this is the only sanctioned deviation from the shared protocol

resnet18.why: ImageNet fine-tune; LR matches the value recorded in the existing checkpoint's resume_config so old and new runs stay comparable

efficientnet_b0.why: ImageNet fine-tune; the reference model for H1-H4

convnext_tiny.why: 28M parameters, roughly 4x EfficientNet-B0's activation memory, so half the per-GPU batch

notes.deviation_policy: Any difference not listed in 'why' is a defect, not a tuning choice.
notes.augmentation: Random horizontal flip, rotation up to rotation_deg, brightness 0.88-1.12, per-channel gain 0.92-1.08, all applied on the GPU inside the training engine. Identical for every architecture.
notes.normalisation: smallcnn uses mean=std=0.5; the pretrained models use ImageNet statistics. This is fixed by the architecture, not a choice.
notes.batch_note: local_batch_size is per GPU; global batch = local_batch_size x 2.
notes.pilot_note: The pilot run uses 1 epoch per architecture to measure wall-clock and confirm no OOM at these batch sizes before committing to 12 runs.
